svg.title: Vitruvian Manager
svg.desc: Vitruvian Manager's mark (VM is made by JDP-Iq): Vitruvius, VM's mascot, in an amber hard hat, his four arms and four legs spread inside a circle. Vitruvius, VM's mascot, was drawn by an AI image model (ChatGPT) from VM's own description; no person drew or retouched the pictures. He is a new character, not a copy of Leonardo's drawing.
